texte.Aucune réponse, aucun score et aucun nom: No answer, no score and no name is sent to the server: grading happens on your side, and progress is kept by your browser alone. A named record of what each employee does not know about security would, on its own, be the set-up’s first security problem. The downside is accepted: clearing the site’s data clears your progress.
texte.Ce que ce QCM est, et ce qu’il n’est pas: What this quiz is, and what it is not
texte.Choisissez un niveau — débutant, intermé: Choose a level — beginner, intermediate, experienced, expert. Answer with the keyboard (A, B, C, D) or the mouse. The correction opens immediately: why the right answer is right, why each of the others is not, the frameworks cited, and the measures to put in place. A hint is available before you answer.
texte.Débutant demande de reconnaître la menac: Beginner asks you to recognise the threat; intermediate, to know which control applies and where; experienced, to make the call under regulatory pressure; expert, to know what breaks when two controls contradict each other. Failing the expert level when you use an assistant day to day is not a failure: that level is not written for that role.
texte.En pratique : ce qu’on met en place: In practice: what you put in place
texte.Faites passer le QCM de sécurité de l’IA: Have each person take the AI security quiz at the level matching their role, and look at the profile by domain rather than the score: model threats, agents and tools, data and secrecy, regulation, governance, fraud.
texte.La banque de questions n’a pas pu être c: The question bank could not be loaded. Reload the page; if the problem persists, the service is unavailable.
texte.La part des questions réussies à leur de: The share of questions answered correctly on their last attempt, domain by domain, all levels combined. The lowest domain points to the training to take first — the competency framework gives the level expected.
texte.Le domaine le plus faible désigne la for: The weakest domain points to the training to take first — and it does so on an observed answer, not on a declaration.
texte.Le rang d’ensemble s’ouvre quand les qua: The overall rank unlocks when each of the four levels has a medal. Levels still without a medal:
texte.Les quatre niveaux ne mesurent pas la mê: The four levels do not measure the same thing
texte.Les quatre niveaux sont terminés. Votre: All four levels are done. Your rank is read from the lowest medal obtained, never from the average: it is the foundation that protects the institution day to day.
texte.Les trois référentiels OWASP — où se sit: The three OWASP frameworks — where this question sits
texte.L’obligation de littératie en IA de l’ar: The AI literacy obligation in Article # of Regulation (EU) #/# is demonstrated through a documented training programme suited to each role. This quiz is a useful exhibit of it, never the exhibit. For the level expected of a person and the training that reaches it, use the competency framework.
texte.Pourquoi les autres réponses sont fausse: Why the other answers are wrong
texte.Questions réussies à leur dernier passag: Questions answered correctly on their last attempt:
texte.RIEN NE REMONTE : les réponses restent d: NOTHING IS SENT BACK: answers stay in each person’s browser, by design. To track a team, go through the training programme and its attendance records. And do not use a score as proof of literacy: Article # expects a documented programme, not a questionnaire result.
texte.Une médaille se gagne sur le taux de bon: A medal is earned on a level’s rate of correct answers, in a single attempt. Below the first tier, the level is to be retaken.
texte.Une médaille se gagne sur un taux de bon: A medal is earned on a rate of correct answers within a level. The lowest tier already requires most of the answers, and the highest requires a flawless run — in security, the question you miss is precisely the one that opens the incident. The overall rank is read from the LOWEST medal across the four levels, never from their average.
texte.questions, quatre niveaux, une médaille: questions, four levels, one medal per level
texte.À mesurer ce que vous RECONNAISSEZ, sur: To measure what you RECOGNISE, on scenes taken from banking, finance and insurance: injection through a customer e-mail, an agent posting an entry, a cloned voice on a payment order, an evaded fraud model, a fabricated claims document. Every answer is explained, and ends with what you put in place on Monday morning.
